verdict.rationale: Forter documents its own background automation: fraud decisions, automated dispute handling with evidence recommendations, and decision-driven actions such as Auto Invoice capture that run without manual steps once configured. However, there is no documented user-facing builder for defining custom autonomous automations, triggers, or schedules; the 'Forter Agents' claim is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, recurring schedules or custom triggers, documentation of how 'Forter Agents' operate autonomously, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
